answer.verdict: refuted. zsiopdrv's only sifcmd handler is cid 0 at 0x4f4f4: it stores packet+32 (size>>11, clamped to >=0) at 0x52200 and returns. It does not copy a SIF payload into the stream at 0xc7000. In a 104s menu+fight the EE calls sceSifSendCmd twice (SET_SREG 0x80000001 psize 0x18, and one cid 0 psize 0x24). The 10240-byte stream source is already nonzero=6156 with that handler dropped. SIF-cmd dispatch was not implemented.

facts.c: sifcmd ordinal 10 is called once, at 0x4e5f8, with delay-slot a0=0, a1=handler 0x4f4f4, a2=harg 0x523b4. Preceding ordinal 8 is SetCmdBuffer(0x529e8, 64); that buffer is 0/64 nonzero in the image. Ordinal 10 falls through to setV0(0).

Handler 0x4f4f4 is lw v1,32(a0); bgez else v1=0; sw v1,0x52200; jr ra. No memcpy, no 0xc7000, harg unused. 0x52200 readers bgez over errors or, at 0x49620, save the word, store -1, and IOP-SendCmd cid 2 psize 36.

music-2 (TEKKEN4_SOUND=1, menus+fight, perf through second 89, wav 104.006s) logged exactly two sceSifSendCmd and the cap is 5: cid 0x80000001 psize 0x18 at boot, cid 0 psize 0x24 once at perf second 43. Guard word 0x1ccd400 blocks a second cid-0 send. SDK cids 0x80000002/08/09/0a/0c are not hit.
The cid-0 sender 0x229628(src,dest,size) writes packet+32 = size>>11 and passes src/dest/size in a3/t0/t1. The HLE reads stack+0x10, so the logged extra=0x2 is not t0.
With the handler dropped, the first VoiceTrans of 10240 bytes from 0xc7000 has nonzero=6156. The logged 256-byte refills have nonzero=3. music-6 shows six sceCdRead, not two.

contra: Prompt said the IRQ refill source is all zeros (music-6 stderr 44-61). Line 45 is nonzero=6156; lines 49-61 are nonzero=3.
Prompt said only two IOP sceCdRead. music-6 stderr 64-70 lists six (lsn 10614, 10678, 10742, 10806, 10870, 10934).
